purpose: Reconcile raid-only accessory names against canonical accessory identities without treating raid appearances as duplicate inventory items.

evidence: Online Raid Quest documentation lists Tapion Wig as a raid accessory and separately lists Tapion Wig through multiple raid events.
records.notes: Keep distinct from Tapion's Sword and Tapion clothing. Current raid history establishes the identity, but this pass does not establish a pre-existing canonical ID.

evidence: Online Raid Quest documentation lists Cheelai Wig separately from Cheelai Wig (w/Scouter).
records.notes: Treat the no-scouter and with-scouter versions as separate named variants until inventory evidence proves otherwise.

evidence: Online Raid Quest documentation lists the scouter variant separately.
records.notes: Do not merge with the normal Cheelai Wig.

evidence: Crystal Raid documentation lists Tights Hat as an accessory reward.
records.notes: Requires canonical identity promotion after cross-source inventory reconciliation.

evidence: Crystal Raid documentation lists Universe 6 Supreme Kai's Helper's Hat as an accessory reward.
records.notes: Name variants are retained; no duplicate canonical record created.

evidence: Crystal Raid documentation lists Lord Zuno's Topknot Wig as an accessory reward.
records.notes: Requires identity reconciliation with the broader accessory catalog.

evidence: Raid documentation lists Android 21 Wig & Glasses as a combined reward name.
records.notes: Do not split the combined reward into two canonical accessories until independent inventory evidence establishes separate collectibles.

evidence: Raid documentation lists Hercule Wig 2 through raid routes.
records.notes: Must remain distinct from Hercule Wig unless the game's inventory names demonstrate equivalence.

evidence: Raid documentation lists Tiencha Wig through Yamcha's raid and also lists Accessory Shop as another route.
records.notes: This is a confirmed multi-route identity candidate, not two separate accessories.

rules: Raid reward appearance is an acquisition route, not a new canonical identity by itself.
Named cosmetic variants remain separate until evidence supports merging them.
Combined reward labels are not split automatically into independent accessories.
Historical raid availability does not establish current availability.
No drop rate or reward probability is inferred from an accessory appearing in a raid reward table.
